name: GlyNAC

lead: GlyNAC is a combination of glycine and N-acetylcysteine proposed to restore glutathione levels that decline with age. It is sold as an over-the-counter supplement.

Small trials by one academic group in older adults reported improved glutathione, inflammation markers and some physical function measures. Sample sizes are small, and appearance effects have not been shown.

paras: Cysteine (from NAC) and glycine are the two limiting amino acids for glutathione synthesis, so supplementing both is hypothesized to improve antioxidant capacity and mitochondrial function.
Adverse effects are mainly gastrointestinal, from NAC. Trial doses are large and long-term safety has not been established. Legal as a supplement.
